instruction.description: User instruction for this deck generation; always the highest priority.

roomId.description: Target room id injected by the gateway. Required.

title.description: Deck title from the user-confirmed draft document.

audience.description: Audience from the draft confirmation card.

visualThesis.description: One-line visual thesis from the style stage, if available.

draftPages.description: User-confirmed draft pages. This is the only content source of truth.

deckStyle.description: Minimal design brief from the confirmed style card (composition / darkCover / motif / palette). Bias page compositions and visual anchors toward it while keeping storyboard variety.

compositionFeedback.description: Composition-family validation feedback from the previous attempt. Rebalance page compositions; do not rewrite content.

pageOffset.description: Batch mode: 0-based first page index of this batch.

pageCount.description: Batch mode: total pages in the deck.
